after.en: Encoding-aware read, write, edit and grep tools for DSH: keeps UTF-8 BOM and round-trips GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-1251 and UTF-16 bytes exactly.
after.zh: 读写、编辑和搜索多种编码的文件，保留 UTF-8 BOM，并支持 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS 等编码。

before.en: A standalone DSH wallpaper background plugin with built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and a read-only Wallpaper Engine library. That library needs the companion plugin dsh-wallpaper-engine-api.
before.zh: DSH 独立壁纸背景插件，支持内置壁纸、自定义上传及只读的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需安装配套插件 dsh-wallpaper-engine-api）。

after.en: A standalone DSH wallpaper background plugin with built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and a read-only Wallpaper Engine library. That library needs the companion plugin dsh-wallpaper-engine-api.
after.zh: 设置内置或上传的壁纸，也可读取 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库，后者需安装配套插件。

before.en: Openrouter Providers
before.zh: OpenRouter 供应商列表

after.en: OpenRouter Providers
after.zh: OpenRouter 供应商列表

before.en: OpenRouter Provider List sets provider and quantization limits for OpenRouter requests, injected as provider.only, provider.order, and provider.quantizations. It can optionally route through billion-context.
before.zh: OpenRouter 供应商列表：设置请求的供应商与量化位数限制，以 provider.only、provider.order、provider.quantizations 注入，可选经 billion-context 代理转发。

after.en: OpenRouter Provider List sets provider and quantization limits for OpenRouter requests, injected as provider.only, provider.order, and provider.quantizations. It can optionally route through billion-context.
after.zh: 设置 OpenRouter 请求使用的上游供应商、调用顺序和量化规格，可经 billion-context 转发。

before.en: Quality-first topic memory for DSH. Each topic keeps its starting question, conclusion, impact, and dependencies, not the process, in a local, git-traced OKF bundle with budgeted, LLM-free injection.
before.zh: 面向 DSH 的质量优先主题记忆：每个主题保留起始问题、结论、影响与依赖而非过程，存储于本地、可 git 追溯的 OKF 包中，并以预算控制、无需 LLM 的方式注入。

after.en: Quality-first topic memory for DSH. Each topic keeps its starting question, conclusion, impact, and dependencies, not the process, in a local, git-traced OKF bundle with budgeted, LLM-free injection.
after.zh: 按主题保存问题、结论、影响和依赖，用本地 Git 跟踪版本，并在预算范围内注入相关记忆。

before.en: Deterministic context-pruning compaction backend for dsh: zero-LLM summaries, /dcp command, works out of the box. Design references Opencode-DCP.
before.zh: dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的确定性上下文裁剪压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要、/dcp 命令，开箱即用。设计参考了 Opencode-DCP 等项目。

after.en: Deterministic context-pruning compaction backend for dsh: zero-LLM summaries, /dcp command, works out of the box. Design references Opencode-DCP.
after.zh: 按规则裁剪和压缩上下文，无需模型生成摘要，可通过 /dcp 调用。

before.en: Paoding: an installer for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) orchestration mode, with host-aware role tool filtering and a visual configurator on the Web settings page.
before.zh: 庖丁：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）编排模式安装器，提供感知宿主的角色工具过滤，以及 Web 设置页的可视化配置器。

after.en: Paoding: an installer for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) orchestration mode, with host-aware role tool filtering and a visual configurator on the Web settings page.
after.zh: 安装庖丁编排模式，在网页中配置角色，并按宿主环境筛选各角色可用工具。

before.en: DSH startup animation and background plugin: plays a local video full-screen at launch without blocking startup, plus a persistent background video layer with adjustable opacity and playback controls.
before.zh: DSH 启动动画与动态背景插件：启动时全屏播放本地视频，并提供可调节不透明度与播放控制的持久背景视频层。无第三方依赖，跨平台。

after.en: DSH startup animation and background plugin: plays a local video full-screen at launch without blocking startup, plus a persistent background video layer with adjustable opacity and playback controls.
after.zh: 启动时播放本地全屏视频，也可设置常驻动态背景，调整透明度和播放方式。

before.en: Sets default models for DSH subagents, with sequential or random assignment across models and cross-vendor failover on connection errors. Shows the current vendor and model in trajectory and conversation views.
before.zh: 为 DSH 子代理配置默认模型：支持多模型顺序或随机分配、跨供应商连接失败故障转移，并在轨迹与对话视图中显示当前供应商和模型，同时以一行提示词把当前路由注入子代理上下文。

after.en: Sets default models for DSH subagents, with sequential or random assignment across models and cross-vendor failover on connection errors. Shows the current vendor and model in trajectory and conversation views.
after.zh: 为子 Agent 分配默认模型，支持顺序或随机选择，以及连接失败时切换供应商。

before.en: Worktree Space gives each task its own space across one or more Git repos, with a worktree per repo on one task branch. It merges back to each target branch and can hand conflicts to an agent.
before.zh: 工作树空间：一任务一空间，多路并行。每个任务在涉及的各 Git 仓库中以独立 worktree 运行，完成后合并回各目标分支，冲突可交给智能体处理。

after.en: Worktree Space gives each task its own space across one or more Git repos, with a worktree per repo on one task branch. It merges back to each target branch and can hand conflicts to an agent.
after.zh: 为每个任务建立独立的 Git 工作树，支持跨仓库执行、合并回目标分支，并把冲突交给 Agent 处理。

before.en: SenseNova connect bundle for the Harness Web UI. It has a Token Plan credit panel with per-pool quota windows, per-model usage, and a self-renewing token, and can register SenseNova models as a provider.
before.zh: 面向 Harness 网页界面的 SenseNova 连接套件：Token Plan 额度面板（含各额度池配额、各模型消耗与自动续期令牌），并可注册供应商接入 SenseNova 模型。

after.en: SenseNova connect bundle for the Harness Web UI. It has a Token Plan credit panel with per-pool quota windows, per-model usage, and a self-renewing token, and can register SenseNova models as a provider.
after.zh: 接入 SenseNova 模型，查看 Token Plan 额度、各模型用量和配额周期，支持令牌自动续期。

before.en: DeepSeek Harness billing plugin: shows account balance and this session's billed spend, with a session-header badge.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 计费插件：显示账户余额及本次会话的计费消费，并在会话头部显示徽标。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness billing plugin: shows account balance and this session's billed spend, with a session-header badge.
after.zh: 显示账户余额和当前会话的实际计费金额，在会话标题旁提供费用标记。

before.en: Opencode Patch
before.zh: OpenCode 补丁

after.en: OpenCode Patch
after.zh: OpenCode 补丁

before.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上的 OpenCode：会话亲和性、Zen/Go 网关来源请求头、免费档工具回退，以及实时 Go 配额显示。

after.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
after.zh: 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

before.en: Opencode Go Plus
before.zh: OpenCode Go Plus

after.en: OpenCode Go Plus
after.zh: OpenCode Go Plus

before.en: DSH plugin: standalone OpenCode GO LlmAdapter that owns its provider route, with per-model wire protocols (including union-alpha's anthropic-messages), and manages models, context and modalities.
before.zh: DSH 插件：独立的 OpenCode GO LlmAdapter，独占其提供商路由（按模型区分线路协议，包括 union-alpha 的 anthropic-messages），并管理模型、上下文与模态。

after.en: DSH plugin: standalone OpenCode GO LlmAdapter that owns its provider route, with per-model wire protocols (including union-alpha's anthropic-messages), and manages models, context and modalities.
after.zh: 独立接入 OpenCode Go，为不同模型设置通信协议，管理上下文和输入类型。

before.en: Ptc Plus
before.zh: Ptc Plus

after.en: PTC Plus
after.zh: PTC Plus

before.en: A session-bound agent-native REPL for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode.
before.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness PTC 模式的会话绑定型原生代理 REPL。

after.en: A session-bound agent-native REPL for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode.
after.zh: 为 DSH 的 PTC 模式提供与会话绑定的 REPL 交互执行环境。

before.en: dsh panel plugin: sidebar git management — Local Changes / All Commits, branch/tag/stash management, merge with conflict handling.
before.zh: dsh 面板插件：侧边栏 Git 管理，包括本地更改 / 所有提交、分支/标签/储藏管理，以及带冲突处理的合并。

after.en: dsh panel plugin: sidebar git management — Local Changes / All Commits, branch/tag/stash management, merge with conflict handling.
after.zh: 在侧栏查看改动与提交，管理分支、标签和暂存记录，支持合并及冲突处理。

before.en: dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark, with round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards and steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot).
before.zh: dsh 插件：通过飞书/Lark 驱动已有的 dsh 会话，支持轮次卡片、交互式恢复、询问用户卡片与 steer（仅出站 WebSocket 机器人）。

after.en: dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark, with round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards and steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot).
after.zh: 从飞书操作已有 DSH 会话，通过卡片查看轮次、回答问题、恢复任务或补充指令。

before.en: Map and routing tools for DeepSeek Harness: driving, transit, walking, and cycling route planning, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search via Amap (高德) or free OSM/OSRM.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 地图与路线工具：驾车、公交、步行、骑行路线规划，地理编码、逆地理编码与 POI 搜索，可使用高德或免费的 OSM/OSRM。

after.en: Map and routing tools for DeepSeek Harness: driving, transit, walking, and cycling route planning, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search via Amap (高德) or free OSM/OSRM.
after.zh: 通过高德或 OSM/OSRM 查询地点，规划驾车、公交、步行和骑行路线。

before.en: Assistant reply translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel).
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的助手回复翻译（兼容 OpenAI 的通道）。

after.en: Assistant reply translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel).
after.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 的模型接口，翻译网页会话中的助手回复。

before.en: Structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: a dangerous-call gate, output self-check, tool narrowing and loop guard, backed by a pluggable adjudication model.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代理循环的结构化决策层：包含危险调用拦截、输出自检、工具收窄和循环防护，由可插拔的裁决模型提供支持。

after.en: Structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: a dangerous-call gate, output self-check, tool narrowing and loop guard, backed by a pluggable adjudication model.
after.zh: 在 Agent 执行过程中检查高风险调用、核对输出、限制工具范围，并检测重复循环。

before.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness in a single package: JSONL storage, local vector search (BGE-M3), four model tools, automatic recall injection, and a management panel.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地长期记忆（单包单入口）：JSONL 存储、本地向量检索（BGE-M3）、四个模型工具、自动召回注入与管理面板。

after.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness in a single package: JSONL storage, local vector search (BGE-M3), four model tools, automatic recall injection, and a management panel.
after.zh: 用本地 JSONL 和 BGE-M3 向量检索保存长期记忆，支持自动召回和面板管理。

before.en: Ecosystem
before.zh: 生态

after.en: VibeDev Ecosystem
after.zh: VibeDev 生态

before.en: VibeDev Ecosystem: discover, install, and manage plugins made by VibeDev, verify stable release updates in real time, and browse the DSH community marketplace.
before.zh: VibeDev 生态：发现、安装和管理 VibeDev 出品的插件，实时核对正式版更新，并可浏览 DSH 社区市场。

after.en: VibeDev Ecosystem: discover, install, and manage plugins made by VibeDev, verify stable release updates in real time, and browse the DSH community marketplace.
after.zh: 发现、安装和管理 VibeDev 插件，检查版本更新，并浏览 DSH 社区市场。

before.en: Mcp Manager Plus
before.zh: Mcp Manager Plus

after.en: MCP Manager Plus
after.zh: MCP Manager Plus

before.en: MCP manager settings page for DeepSeek Harness: list, enable, configure and add MCP servers from the browser, written durably to the profile's user patch layer.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理设置页：可在浏览器中列出、启用、配置和添加 MCP 服务器，并持久写入配置档的用户补丁层。

after.en: MCP manager settings page for DeepSeek Harness: list, enable, configure and add MCP servers from the browser, written durably to the profile's user patch layer.
after.zh: 在网页设置中添加、配置和开关 MCP 服务器，配置保存到当前 Profile。

before.en: DSH pure Plan B plugin bundle: .dspack export/import with multiple profiles, zero changes to official source, zero third-party plugins.
before.zh: DSH 纯方案 B 插件包：支持 .dspack 导出/导入及多配置档，零官方源码改动，零第三方插件依赖。

after.en: DSH pure Plan B plugin bundle: .dspack export/import with multiple profiles, zero changes to official source, zero third-party plugins.
after.zh: 导出和导入 .dspack 插件包，支持多个 Profile，无需修改 DSH 官方源码。

before.en: Password login gateway for dsh web: auto-generated initial password with forced onboarding, login, password change with real request interception, and OTP two-factor auth.
before.zh: dsh 网页版的密码登录网关：自动生成初始密码并强制完成首次引导，支持登录、通过真实请求拦截修改密码，以及 OTP 双因素认证。

after.en: Password login gateway for dsh web: auto-generated initial password with forced onboarding, login, password change with real request interception, and OTP two-factor auth.
after.zh: 为网页端添加密码登录、初次设置、密码修改和 OTP 双因素认证。

before.en: Track your DeepSeek Harness coding time on Hackatime (WakaTime-compatible heartbeats).
before.zh: 将你的 DeepSeek Harness 编码时长记录到 Hackatime（兼容 WakaTime 心跳）。

after.en: Track your DeepSeek Harness coding time on Hackatime (WakaTime-compatible heartbeats).
after.zh: 将 DSH 编码时长记录到 Hackatime，兼容 WakaTime 心跳协议。

before.en: Host-side plugin for DSH Remote Control: pairs this machine's DeepSeek Harness with a relay so a WeChat mini program can send commands, stream output, and answer approvals. Payloads are end-to-end encrypted.
before.zh: DSH 远程控制的宿主侧插件：将本机 DeepSeek Harness 与中继配对，微信小程序可发送指令、查看流式输出并回答审批。载荷端到端加密。

after.en: Host-side plugin for DSH Remote Control: pairs this machine's DeepSeek Harness with a relay so a WeChat mini program can send commands, stream output, and answer approvals. Payloads are end-to-end encrypted.
after.zh: 将本机 DSH 连接到中继，通过微信小程序发送指令、查看流式输出和处理审批；消息内容端到端加密。

before.en: dsh plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model lists in step with the pi.dev gateway, written through the official settings seam.
before.zh: dsh 插件：通过官方设置接口，使 llm-pi-ai 提供商路由的模型列表与 pi.dev 网关保持同步。

after.en: dsh plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model lists in step with the pi.dev gateway, written through the official settings seam.
after.zh: 同步 pi.dev 网关模型列表，通过 DSH 设置更新 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置。

before.en: References files, sessions, commands, skills, and historical external AI chats from the DSH @ menu.
before.zh: 通过 DSH 的 @ 菜单引用文件、会话、命令、技能以及外部 AI 的历史对话。

after.en: References files, sessions, commands, skills, and historical external AI chats from the DSH @ menu.
after.zh: 通过 @ 菜单引用文件、会话、命令、技能，以及其他 AI 工具中的历史对话。

before.en: Adds thinking levels to third-party models in DSH, with a Thinking toggle and intensity/modality editor on the Models page and a provider-to-model picker in the composer. It also takes over request headers and user-agent per route.
before.zh: 为 DSH 中的第三方模型补齐思考等级：官方 Models 页提供 Thinking 开关和强度/模态编辑器，输入框模型菜单提供供应商到模型的选择器，并可按路由接管请求头与 user-agent。

after.en: Adds thinking levels to third-party models in DSH, with a Thinking toggle and intensity/modality editor on the Models page and a provider-to-model picker in the composer. It also takes over request headers and user-agent per route.
after.zh: 为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入，可按模型配置请求头与 User-Agent。

before.en: Mcp Adapter
before.zh: MCP 适配器

after.en: MCP Adapter
after.zh: MCP 适配器

before.en: dsh plugin: token-efficient prompt-side shim for the official MCP client that folds mcp__* tool schemas out of every assembled prompt and exposes two constant meta-tools (starting with mcp_list).
before.zh: dsh 插件：面向官方 MCP 客户端的省 token 提示词端适配层，从每次组装的提示词中折叠 mcp__* 工具 schema，并提供两个固定的元工具（以 mcp_list 开头）。

after.en: dsh plugin: token-efficient prompt-side shim for the official MCP client that folds mcp__* tool schemas out of every assembled prompt and exposes two constant meta-tools (starting with mcp_list).
after.zh: 按需检索和加载 MCP 工具，减少每次提示词中重复携带的工具定义。

before.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的网易云音乐（music.163.com）播放器与 AI DJ：侧边栏页面支持应用内播放、扫码登录，并提供由代理工具整理播放队列的功能。

after.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
after.zh: 在侧栏播放网易云音乐，支持扫码登录和由 Agent 整理播放队列。

before.en: DSH inline follow-up questions answered in a side card: select text in chat or task areas to ask in place, with a separate subagent streaming the answer, optionally sent back to the main conversation.
before.zh: DSH 划词追问（侧边卡片作答）：在聊天区与任务区选中文本就地追问，答案由独立子代理在侧边卡片里流式呈现，也可选择落回主对话。

after.en: DSH inline follow-up questions answered in a side card: select text in chat or task areas to ask in place, with a separate subagent streaming the answer, optionally sent back to the main conversation.
after.zh: 选中文字后在侧边卡片中追问，由独立子 Agent 流式回答，结果可发回主对话。

before.en: DSH web search provider chosen by vendor and protocol: Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages with built-in search tools, plus standalone search APIs.
before.zh: DSH 网页搜索提供方，按供应商与协议组合选择：支持 Chat Completions、Responses 和 Anthropic Messages 的内置搜索工具，以及独立搜索 API。

after.en: DSH web search provider chosen by vendor and protocol: Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages with built-in search tools, plus standalone search APIs.
after.zh: 为网页搜索选择供应商和接口协议，支持模型内置搜索及独立搜索 API。

before.en: Automatically manages dsh session titles in a date｜type｜topic format, with a model summarizing the type and topic of the whole conversation.
before.zh: 按“日期｜类型｜主题”格式自动管理 dsh 会话标题：由模型总结整个对话的类型与主题。

after.en: Automatically manages dsh session titles in a date｜type｜topic format, with a model summarizing the type and topic of the whole conversation.
after.zh: 由模型概括会话主题，按“日期｜类型｜主题”格式自动命名。

before.en: DSH todo floating ball: a draggable widget showing live progress of the session's todo_write list (total, done, in progress), with click to expand and status colours. Works on desktop and web.
before.zh: DSH 待办悬浮球：可拖动的悬浮球实时显示当前会话 todo_write 任务清单的进度（总数、完成数、进行中），点击可展开或折叠完整清单，并以状态颜色区分（待办灰、进行中橙色脉动、完成绿）；支持桌面端与网页端。

after.en: DSH todo floating ball: a draggable widget showing live progress of the session's todo_write list (total, done, in progress), with click to expand and status colours. Works on desktop and web.
after.zh: 用可拖动悬浮球显示待办总数、完成数和进行中任务，点击可展开清单。

before.en: Use Agnes in DSH with at-a-glance quota, models, and image and video tools; image recognition and thinking levels are auto-filled, and AgnesCode credentials are reused automatically.
before.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Agnes：一览额度、模型，以及图像和视频工具；图像识别与思考级别自动填写，并自动复用 AgnesCode 凭据。

after.en: Use Agnes in DSH with at-a-glance quota, models, and image and video tools; image recognition and thinking levels are auto-filled, and AgnesCode credentials are reused automatically.
after.zh: 接入 Agnes 模型和图片、视频工具，查看额度，并复用 AgnesCode 登录凭据。

before.en: Session-sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: git-backed cross-machine session sync with its own web settings surface, row-menu action, and sync-records dialog

before.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多主机 SSH 隧道与 SSHManager 工具，授权按项目划分。

after.en: Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness, with project-scoped grants.
after.zh: 管理多台主机的 SSH 隧道，并按项目授予连接权限。

before.en: DSH Web Git Sidebar: VS Code-style left-rail Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with branch switching, commit graph, per-commit previews and a session-following footer entry.
before.zh: DSH Web Git 侧边栏：仿 VS Code 风格的左侧 Git 面板，支持分支切换、提交图谱、逐次提交预览，以及跟随会话的页脚入口。

after.en: DSH Web Git Sidebar: VS Code-style left-rail Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with branch switching, commit graph, per-commit previews and a session-following footer entry.
after.zh: 在左侧 Git 面板中切换分支、查看提交图和每次提交的内容。

before.en: Lets the DeepSeek Harness web composer accept folders via drag, paste or the /folder command, with a host folder dialog and @path mentions.
before.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框支持拖入或粘贴文件夹，并提供宿主文件夹对话框、/folder 命令及 @path 提及。

after.en: Lets the DeepSeek Harness web composer accept folders via drag, paste or the /folder command, with a host folder dialog and @path mentions.
after.zh: 在网页输入框拖入、粘贴或选择文件夹，生成 @path 引用，也可使用 /folder 命令。

before.en: Openrouter Spend
before.zh: OpenRouter 花费

after.en: OpenRouter Spend
after.zh: OpenRouter 花费

before.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today, per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示 OpenRouter 账户今日实际扣费，包括每个对话与总计，位于输入框下方及设置页，并按模型与 API Key 拆分。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today, per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
after.zh: 显示 OpenRouter 今日和各会话的实际扣费，按模型与 API 密钥查看明细。

before.en: Balance monitor for third-party services in DeepSeek Harness: enter an API key and check remaining quota every 1 to 30 minutes, with a dashboard and sidebar status icon. Supports Tavily, Bocha, Firecrawl, SerpAPI, SearchApi, ScrapingBee, ScraperAPI, and TinyFish.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 第三方服务余额监控：录入 API Key，按 1/5/10/30 分钟定时查询剩余额度，提供主面板看板与侧边栏状态图标。支持 Tavily、博查、Firecrawl、SerpAPI、SearchApi、ScrapingBee、ScraperAPI、TinyFish。

after.en: Balance monitor for third-party services in DeepSeek Harness: enter an API key and check remaining quota every 1 to 30 minutes, with a dashboard and sidebar status icon. Supports Tavily, Bocha, Firecrawl, SerpAPI, SearchApi, ScrapingBee, ScraperAPI, and TinyFish.
after.zh: 定时查询 Tavily、博查、Firecrawl、TinyFish 等服务的剩余额度，提供看板和侧栏状态图标。

before.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在网页配置成功启动后运行用户自定义的命令。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
after.zh: 在 DSH 网页服务成功启动后，执行用户设定的命令。

before.en: Ark models, web-search tools and Web UI in one bundle
before.zh: 方舟模型、网页搜索工具与 Web UI 集成于一个插件包。

after.en: Ark models, web-search tools and Web UI in one bundle
after.zh: 在一个插件包中接入方舟模型、网页搜索和配套界面。

before.en: Multi2API account pool: turns multiple WorkBuddy accounts into separate, non-interfering models in DSH.
before.zh: Multi2API 账号池：把多个 WorkBuddy 账号变成 DSH 里一个个互不干扰的模型。

after.en: Multi2API account pool: turns multiple WorkBuddy accounts into separate, non-interfering models in DSH.
after.zh: 管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号，在 DSH 中分别作为独立模型使用。

before.en: Semantic workspace search plugin for DSH (zg): zg_search, zg_index, and zg_status, plus a local embedding settings card, systemPrompt routing rules, and a guard safety net.
before.zh: DSH 工作区语义检索插件（zg）：提供 zg_search、zg_index、zg_status 工具，以及本地 embedding 设置卡片、systemPrompt 路由规则和 guard 安全兜底。

after.en: Semantic workspace search plugin for DSH (zg): zg_search, zg_index, and zg_status, plus a local embedding settings card, systemPrompt routing rules, and a guard safety net.
after.zh: 用 Zvec 对工作区建立语义索引并搜索，提供本地向量模型配置和调用规则。

before.en: Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
before.zh: 永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 对话及其所有本地数据：会话日志、派生缓存、工作区索引条目、溢出文件以及未被引用的附件。

after.en: Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
after.zh: 永久删除会话及其本地数据，包括日志、缓存、工作区索引记录和不再引用的附件。

before.en: Custom Js
before.zh: 自定义 JS

after.en: Custom JS
after.zh: 自定义 JS

before.en: DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image or video dynamic wallpaper behind them.
before.zh: DSH 插件：为界面表面提供统一的磨砂玻璃材质，并可在其后设置图片或视频动态壁纸。

after.en: DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image or video dynamic wallpaper behind them.
after.zh: 为界面应用统一磨砂玻璃效果，可搭配图片或视频壁纸。

before.en: Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
before.zh: 为第三方提供商模型设置图片输入与推理强度等级。

after.en: Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
after.zh: 为第三方模型设置图片输入能力和推理强度。

before.en: Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
before.zh: 在中间栏以关系图形式审阅变更集，每个节点都可点击跳转到对应源码行。

after.en: Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
after.zh: 用关系图审阅代码改动，点击节点即可跳转到相应源码行。

before.en: Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
before.zh: 在 DSH 0.2.1+ 中将本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定 CIDR 网段（如 Tailscale），可选数字访问码，并提供仅作用于远程页面的手机布局。

after.en: Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
after.zh: 将网页界面开放给指定网段，可设置数字访问码，并为远程页面提供手机布局。

before.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）宿主插件：模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，使回答呈现为文字-图示-文字的结构，而非大段文字。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
after.zh: 让模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，结合文字解释内容。

before.en: Fusion
before.zh: Fusion

after.en: Sidekick
after.zh: Sidekick

before.en: Sidekick: persistent Lead–Sidekick collaboration. Delegate bounded tasks, then accept or send back exact results.
before.zh: Sidekick：持久的 Lead–Sidekick 协作。委派有界任务，然后接受或退回精确结果。

after.en: Sidekick: persistent Lead–Sidekick collaboration. Delegate bounded tasks, then accept or send back exact results.
after.zh: 让主模型与 Sidekick 持续协作，委派明确范围的任务，逐项验收或退回修改。

before.en: DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
before.zh: DSH 插件：盘点 Windows 开发与测试工具链，找出缺失项，并可一键补齐。

after.en: DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
after.zh: 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

before.en: Release Console adds a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry and main-panel page showing each repository's builds and releases. It flags whether local checkouts are ahead or installed copies are outdated.
before.zh: 发布台（Release Console）：DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏入口与主面板页面，展示各仓库的构建与发布情况，标示本地检出是否领先，以及本配置中安装的副本是否过时。

after.en: Release Console adds a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry and main-panel page showing each repository's builds and releases. It flags whether local checkouts are ahead or installed copies are outdated.
after.zh: 在侧栏和主面板查看各仓库构建、发布和安装版本，识别待发布改动及过期安装。

before.en: Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky secondary-development plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud WebAPI, credential-safe config, and a companion domain skill.
before.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的金蝶云星空二次开发插件：基于金蝶云 WebAPI 的类型化工具、凭据安全的配置，以及配套的领域技能。

after.en: Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky secondary-development plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud WebAPI, credential-safe config, and a companion domain skill.
after.zh: 通过金蝶云 WebAPI 进行云星空二次开发，提供配套工具、凭据配置和领域技能。

before.en: Hitl
before.zh: 人在回路

after.en: HITL
after.zh: 人工确认

before.en: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve, modify or reject decision card in the DSH web UI, with an optional countdown.
before.zh: DSH 工具调用的人在回路（Human-in-the-loop）关卡：可将任意工具置于审批、修改或拒绝的决策卡片之后，并可选倒计时。

after.en: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve, modify or reject decision card in the DSH web UI, with an optional countdown.
after.zh: 在工具执行前显示人工确认卡片，可批准、修改或拒绝，并可设置倒计时。

before.en: Media models: standalone image and video model configuration, plus chat generation tools.
before.zh: 媒体模型：独立图片与视频模型配置、聊天生成工具

after.en: Media models: standalone image and video model configuration, plus chat generation tools.
after.zh: 独立配置图片和视频模型，并在会话中调用生成工具。

before.en: dsh plugin: an unattended approval gate. Subagent, scheduled and cron approval requests get a bounded answer window, then settle on a fail-closed default instead of hanging.
before.zh: dsh 插件：无人值守审批关卡。subagent、定时任务及 cron 的审批请求会在有限的答复时间窗口内等待，超时后按失败即关闭（fail closed）的默认值结算，而不会无限挂起。

after.en: dsh plugin: an unattended approval gate. Subagent, scheduled and cron approval requests get a bounded answer window, then settle on a fail-closed default instead of hanging.
after.zh: 为无人值守的子 Agent 和定时任务设置审批等待时限，超时后默认不放行。

before.en: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting with per-word count chips, a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colours, text colour and size, and whole-word matching.
before.zh: 思维链关键词计数与高亮：支持每个词的计数标签（点击可屏蔽）、每词颜色、文字颜色与字号，以及全词匹配。

after.en: Chain-of-thought keyword counting and highlighting with per-word count chips, a click-to-suppress switch, per-word colours, text colour and size, and whole-word matching.
after.zh: 统计和高亮思考内容中的关键词，可设置颜色、字号、完整词匹配，并点击隐藏指定词。

before.en: Notion Oauth Ui
before.zh: Notion Oauth Ui

after.en: Notion OAuth UI
after.zh: Notion OAuth UI

before.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
before.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 在图形界面中连接 Notion，使用官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

after.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
after.zh: 在界面中通过 OAuth 连接官方 Notion MCP，无需另填集成令牌。

before.en: Wonder Tools
before.zh: 工具箱

after.en: Wonder Tools
after.zh: Wonder Tools

before.en: DSH toolbox bundle: one plugin installs five features, each with its own switch: delete conversations, regenerate from here, the /teammate command, cross-session reminders, and auto-naming after the first turn. The plugin page shows one card with five component rows.
before.zh: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能，每项可独立开关：删除对话、重新生成（从这里重来）、队友命令（/teammate）、跨会话提醒，以及首轮结束后自动命名。插件页呈现为 1 张卡片加 5 行组件。

after.en: DSH toolbox bundle: one plugin installs five features, each with its own switch: delete conversations, regenerate from here, the /teammate command, cross-session reminders, and auto-naming after the first turn. The plugin page shows one card with five component rows.
after.zh: 组合提供删除会话、重新生成、/teammate、跨会话提醒和自动命名，各项可独立开关。

before.en: Browser Use
before.zh: 浏览器使用

after.en: Browser Use
after.zh: 浏览器操作

before.en: DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器供应商：将页面读取为带索引的操作空间，然后每次仅执行一项受保护的操作。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
after.zh: 把网页内容整理成带编号的可操作目标，再逐步执行带权限检查的浏览器操作。

before.en: Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
before.zh: 为 DSH 对话提供收藏、复制 id 与路径、按会话删除、空闲时批量归档及收藏筛选，作为对已有归档功能的增量扩展。

after.en: Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
after.zh: 为已有归档功能增加收藏、筛选、复制 ID 和路径、单独删除及空闲时批量归档。

before.en: DSH plugin: inventories your Windows dev/test toolchain, spots the gaps, and fills them with one click.
before.zh: DSH 插件：盘点你的 Windows 开发与测试工具链，找出缺失项，并一键补齐。

after.en: DSH plugin: inventories your Windows dev/test toolchain, spots the gaps, and fills them with one click.
after.zh: 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

before.en: DeepSeek Harness helpers that add 11 UI languages, a Changes panel, input history, Shift+Tab /plan, one-click Continue, and chat resumption after restart. They also add queue drag-and-drop and deeplinks.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 辅助功能：新增 11 种界面语言、变更面板、输入历史、Shift+Tab /plan、一键继续，以及重启后恢复运行中的会话，并支持队列拖拽排序与深度链接。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness helpers that add 11 UI languages, a Changes panel, input history, Shift+Tab /plan, one-click Continue, and chat resumption after restart. They also add queue drag-and-drop and deeplinks.
after.zh: 提供多语言界面、变更面板、输入历史、计划模式和一键继续，支持重启后恢复会话及队列排序。

before.en: Ssh Remote
before.zh: Ssh Remote

after.en: SSH Remote
after.zh: SSH Remote

before.en: DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
before.zh: DSH 插件：SSH 远程运维/开发工具套件（run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull），包含 ControlMaster 连接层、状态面板，以及设置页中的主机管理。

after.en: DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
after.zh: 通过 SSH 执行远程命令和文件读写、搜索、传输，在设置中管理主机与连接状态。

before.en: Password gate: when DSH opens, a password screen appears first, and the app is usable only after unlocking. Supports manual and automatic locking, with passwords stored as one-way scrypt hashes.
before.zh: 密码门禁：打开 DSH 时先显示密码界面，解锁后才能使用；支持手动锁定与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 单向哈希存储。

after.en: Password gate: when DSH opens, a password screen appears first, and the app is usable only after unlocking. Supports manual and automatic locking, with passwords stored as one-way scrypt hashes.
after.zh: 为 DSH 添加密码锁屏，支持手动与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 哈希保存。

before.en: Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
before.zh: 把 DSH 的设置弹窗改成 Codex 风格的整页全屏设置页。

after.en: Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
after.zh: 将设置弹窗改为 Codex 风格的全屏设置页。

before.en: DSH developer tools: Git panel and startup management, as a manifest bundle where each component is its own package.
before.zh: DSH 开发工具：Git 面板与启动管理（清单包，各组件独立成包）。

after.en: DSH developer tools: Git panel and startup management, as a manifest bundle where each component is its own package.
after.zh: 组合提供 Git 面板和启动管理，各功能以独立插件包安装。

before.en: Native token-based themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with custom colors and system font pickers.
before.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供基于设计令牌的原生主题，支持自定义颜色和系统字体选择。

after.en: Native token-based themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with custom colors and system font pickers.
after.zh: 通过界面配色变量应用原生主题，可选择自定义颜色和系统字体。

before.en: Right-sidebar media preview for inline video, audio and HTML, plus a folder gallery where selected media can be added to the video workspace canvas. Works in DSH's sidebar and in dsh-better-sidebar.
before.zh: 右侧栏媒体预览：直接预览视频、音频和 HTML（大文件可拖动进度条，HTML 默认允许脚本），以及文件夹媒体画廊（多选后加入影视工作台画布）；可用于 DSH 自带右侧栏，安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后也可使用。

after.en: Right-sidebar media preview for inline video, audio and HTML, plus a folder gallery where selected media can be added to the video workspace canvas. Works in DSH's sidebar and in dsh-better-sidebar.
after.zh: 在右侧栏预览视频、音频和 HTML，浏览文件夹媒体并选入影视工作台；HTML 默认允许脚本。

before.en: Google Vertex AI provider for DeepSeek Harness: service-account auth for Google-hosted Claude and Gemini models.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Google Vertex AI 提供商：通过服务账号认证，支持 Google 托管的 Claude 与 Gemini 模型。

after.en: Google Vertex AI provider for DeepSeek Harness: service-account auth for Google-hosted Claude and Gemini models.
after.zh: 通过服务账号接入 Google Vertex AI，使用其托管的 Claude 和 Gemini 模型。

before.en: Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: command a DSH agent from WeChat, with support for images, files, and voice-note transcription.
before.zh: Weixin（个人微信，iLink Bot API）渠道插件：在微信中指挥 DSH 智能体，支持图片、文件和语音转写。

after.en: Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: command a DSH agent from WeChat, with support for images, files, and voice-note transcription.
after.zh: 通过微信 iLink Bot 与 DSH 对话，支持图片、文件和语音转写。

before.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for DSH web that mirrors session status, with zone hotspots, feeding, drag, emoji bubbles, a token/cost dashboard, XP and titles, and optional proactive companionship.
before.zh: 住在 DSH Web 中的鲸鱼娘桌宠：镜像会话状态，支持分区热区、拖拽、喂食、表情气泡、Token/费用仪表板、XP/称号养成和可关闭的主动陪伴。

after.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for DSH web that mirrors session status, with zone hotspots, feeding, drag, emoji bubbles, a token/cost dashboard, XP and titles, and optional proactive companionship.
after.zh: 用鲸鱼娘桌宠反映会话状态，支持拖拽、喂食、气泡、用量面板和可关闭的主动陪伴。

before.en: Immersive theme for Arknights players on the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers with edge blur adapted to each image, glass and text colors computed per image, a Rhodes Island icon system, and signature-style authorization and selection interactions.
before.zh: 为《明日方舟》玩家打造的 DSH 网页界面沉浸式主题：12 张整屏壁纸（按画面自适应边缘虚化）、按每张图计算的玻璃与文字颜色、罗德岛图标体系，以及签字式的授权与选择交互。

after.en: Immersive theme for Arknights players on the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers with edge blur adapted to each image, glass and text colors computed per image, a Rhodes Island icon system, and signature-style authorization and selection interactions.
after.zh: 为《明日方舟》玩家提供壁纸、罗德岛图标、按图片调整的明暗配色和签字式授权交互。

before.en: Desktop Ui Reasoning Effort
before.zh: Desktop Ui Reasoning Effort

after.en: Desktop UI Reasoning Effort
after.zh: Desktop UI Reasoning Effort

before.en: DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
before.zh: DSH 插件：在模型设置页为自定义 pi-ai 提供方配置每个模型的推理强度级别，并内置 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 模型的预设。

after.en: DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
after.zh: 在模型设置中调整第三方模型的推理强度，提供 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 预设。

before.en: Lingxi (灵犀) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a desktop cat that reacts to the mood of the work, with five model tools (task, say, react, state, remember) over the pet bridge, plus settings.
before.zh: 灵犀（Lingxi）为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）打造的桌面小猫，会根据工作状态做出反应；通过宠物桥接提供五个模型工具（task/say/react/state/remember）及设置。

after.en: Lingxi (灵犀) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a desktop cat that reacts to the mood of the work, with five model tools (task, say, react, state, remember) over the pet bridge, plus settings.
after.zh: 添加会随工作状态反应的灵犀桌面猫，可通过工具安排任务、说话、切换状态和保存记忆。

before.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn. It uses per-model cache-hit/miss, cache-write, and output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and promos.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，在每个已完成的回合下方显示人民币费用，依据各模型的缓存命中/未命中、缓存写入与输出单价计算，并考虑每周峰谷倍率与限时促销。

after.en: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn. It uses per-model cache-hit/miss, cache-write, and output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and promos.
after.zh: 按模型价格估算每轮人民币费用，区分缓存命中、写入和输出，并考虑峰谷价及促销。

before.en: Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
before.zh: Git 分支与 worktree 管理：输入框工具栏显示并可原地切换当前分支；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及将分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

after.en: Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
after.zh: 在输入框切换和管理 Git 分支，支持远程分支、推送、更新，以及独立 Git 工作树。

before.en: Comfyui Image
before.zh: Comfyui Image

after.en: ComfyUI Image
after.zh: ComfyUI Image

before.en: DSH image generation plugin backed by a local ComfyUI server, exposing one unified generate_image tool (text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, background removal).
before.zh: DSH 图片生成插件：基于本地 ComfyUI 服务，只对外暴露一个统一的 generate_image 工具（文生图、图生图、局部重绘、背景移除）。

after.en: DSH image generation plugin backed by a local ComfyUI server, exposing one unified generate_image tool (text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, background removal).
after.zh: 通过本机 ComfyUI 生成图片，支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘和背景移除。

before.en: Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI: registers 日本語 and provides ja dictionaries for all dsh-web-all family plugin namespaces.
before.zh: DSH 网页界面日语语言包：在共享语言目录中注册日本語，并为 dsh-web-all 系列所有插件命名空间提供 ja 词典。

after.en: Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI: registers 日本語 and provides ja dictionaries for all dsh-web-all family plugin namespaces.
after.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面及 dsh-web-all 系列插件提供日语翻译。

before.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面支持 Ctrl+滚轮缩放页面，并提供屏幕缩放提示标签与“通用”设置项。

after.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
after.zh: 通过 Ctrl+滚轮缩放网页，在界面中显示缩放比例，并提供通用设置项。

before.en: Qqmail Dock
before.zh: QQ 邮箱面板

after.en: QQ Mail Dock
after.zh: QQ 邮箱面板

before.en: QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
before.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 QQ 邮箱：读取最近邮件、查看正文，发送纯文本邮件需经确认。凭据仅从私有 secret.json 读取，不进 git、不入日志、不回显。

after.en: QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
after.zh: 在右侧栏读取 QQ 邮件、查看正文，并在确认后发送纯文本邮件；凭据从私有配置文件读取。

before.en: The /cron command for DeepSeek Harness: runs a prompt on a cron expression or plain-English schedule, parsed in code, with the model as a last resort.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 /cron 命令：按 cron 表达式或自然语言时间安排运行提示词，优先由代码解析，最后才交给模型。

after.en: The /cron command for DeepSeek Harness: runs a prompt on a cron expression or plain-English schedule, parsed in code, with the model as a last resort.
after.zh: 通过 /cron 按 cron 表达式或自然语言安排定时任务，优先由代码解析，必要时使用模型。

before.en: Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
before.zh: 在本机回环地址运行 OpenAI 兼容桥接，将 DSH 中配置的所有模型（官方路由、插件路由及用户声明的供应商）提供给 Midscene 浏览器自动化，后者无需持有任何凭据即可用自然语言操控页面。

after.en: Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
after.zh: 在本机建立兼容 OpenAI 的桥接服务，让 Midscene 使用 DSH 模型进行浏览器自动化，凭据由桥接端处理。

before.en: DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
before.zh: DSH 插件：在两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地文件（对话记录、投影缓存及其 subagent 会话）。

after.en: DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
after.zh: 经两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地记录、缓存及关联子 Agent 会话。

before.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，新增两个代码质量技能：/simplify（对当前 diff 做保持行为不变的清理）与 /code-review（多角度代码审查）。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
after.zh: 提供 /simplify 和 /code-review 技能，清理当前改动并进行多角度代码审查。

before.en: Leafy: an eye-friendly green skin that folds the DSH Web GUI's --dsw-* palette into leafy greens, in both light and dark modes.
before.zh: Leafy：护眼的绿色皮肤，将 DSH 网页界面的 --dsw-* 配色收拢为叶绿色调，同时支持浅色与深色模式。

after.en: Leafy: an eye-friendly green skin that folds the DSH Web GUI's --dsw-* palette into leafy greens, in both light and dark modes.
after.zh: 应用 Leafy 绿色主题，支持浅色与深色模式。

before.en: Zpdf
before.zh: Zpdf

after.en: ZPDF
after.zh: ZPDF

before.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
before.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 ZPDF 工具，支持持久化的 API Key 设置与命令行配置。

after.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
after.zh: 为 DSH 接入 ZPDF 工具，支持 API 密钥保存和命令行配置。

before.en: Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
before.zh: DSH 的增强侧边栏：在同一列中提供文件树、编辑器、变更、任务与侧边聊天，并为每个对话独立保存；同时对外提供服务，供其他插件注册侧边栏项。

after.en: Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
after.zh: 在同一侧栏查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务和旁聊，各会话分别保存状态，也可供其他插件扩展。

before.en: Lets the agent drive DSH's built-in browser in the right sidebar's Browser tab: list tabs, open and navigate pages, read content, run JavaScript, click, fill forms, and log in.
before.zh: 让代理操控 DSH 内置浏览器（右侧栏的浏览器标签页）：列出标签页、打开和导航页面、读取内容、执行 JavaScript、点击、填写表单、登录等。

after.en: Lets the agent drive DSH's built-in browser in the right sidebar's Browser tab: list tabs, open and navigate pages, read content, run JavaScript, click, fill forms, and log in.
after.zh: 让 Agent 操作 DSH 内置浏览器，管理标签页、读取网页、运行 JavaScript、点击和填写表单。

before.en: The core Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI. It registers Japanese and provides ja dictionaries for every DSH core plugin namespace, independent of dsh-i18n-ja, with English fallback for missing keys.
before.zh: DSH 网页界面日语语言包（核心）：注册日语，并为所有 DSH 核心插件命名空间提供 ja 词典。独立于 dsh-i18n-ja，缺失的键回退为英文。

after.en: The core Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI. It registers Japanese and provides ja dictionaries for every DSH core plugin namespace, independent of dsh-i18n-ja, with English fallback for missing keys.
after.zh: 为 DSH 核心界面提供独立日语语言包，缺少翻译时显示英文。

before.en: Media panel in the DSH right sidebar: downloads Douyin/YouTube links with yt-dlp, converts audio to 16 kHz mono WAV with ffmpeg, and transcribes it with the official speechToText (SenseVoice) for subtitles and agent summaries.
before.zh: DSH 右侧栏的媒体面板：将抖音/YouTube 链接交给本机 yt-dlp 下载，用 ffmpeg 转为 16k 单声道 WAV，再由官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）转写，字幕显示在面板中，Agent 可一键总结。

after.en: Media panel in the DSH right sidebar: downloads Douyin/YouTube links with yt-dlp, converts audio to 16 kHz mono WAV with ffmpeg, and transcribes it with the official speechToText (SenseVoice) for subtitles and agent summaries.
after.zh: 用本机 yt-dlp 下载抖音或 YouTube 媒体，经 ffmpeg 和 SenseVoice 转录为字幕，并供 Agent 总结。

before.en: Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的每日日记与日历：journal_record 工具每天追加一个 JSON 文件，右侧栏将其绘制为日历。

after.en: Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.
after.zh: 记录每日日记，按天保存在 JSON 文件中，并在右侧栏日历中查看。

before.en: Links pet-whale and dsh-whale-widget: when the desk pet nears the widget it pretends to work and turns toward it, and the widget greets it with a default bubble, without modifying either plugin's source.
before.zh: 连接 pet-whale 与 dsh-whale-widget：桌宠靠近挂件时进入「假装工作」状态并转身面向挂件；挂件扫到桌宠时用默认气泡播放一段默认文字（不修改两个前置插件的源文件）。

after.en: Links pet-whale and dsh-whale-widget: when the desk pet nears the widget it pretends to work and turns toward it, and the widget greets it with a default bubble, without modifying either plugin's source.
after.zh: 连接桌宠与余额鲸鱼挂件，让两者靠近时触发转身、假装工作和气泡互动。

before.en: General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用使用统计：吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用与活动，在网页界面中以图表展示。是 dsh-plugin-tokspeed 的 TypeScript 超集。

after.en: General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
after.zh: 用图表展示吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用和活跃情况，扩展自 dsh-plugin-tokspeed。

before.en: WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信（iLink / ClawBot）渠道

after.en: WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness
after.zh: 通过微信 iLink/ClawBot 接入 DSH 消息通道。

before.en: Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
before.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏对话添加着色背景、行末彩色圆点，并可为每个对话设置标题字号。

after.en: Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
after.zh: 为侧栏会话设置背景色、彩色标记和标题字号。

before.en: Plugin Builder Hud
before.zh: Plugin Builder Hud

after.en: BuilderHUD
after.zh: BuilderHUD

before.en: BuilderHUD — vitals-cluster skins for the DSH sidebar.
before.zh: BuilderHUD：用于 DSH 侧边栏的生命体征式皮肤。

after.en: BuilderHUD — vitals-cluster skins for the DSH sidebar.
after.zh: 为侧栏添加 BuilderHUD 状态皮肤，显示仪表、徽章和实时 Token 消耗。

before.en: Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工具与 /git 斜杠命令，在宿主进程中运行 git，即使会话 Shell 处于沙箱中，push、pull 和 fetch 也能正常工作。

after.en: Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
after.zh: 通过宿主进程执行 Git 和 /git 命令，即使会话 Shell 在沙箱中也可推送、拉取和获取更新。

before.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
before.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 能力开放给小智语音助手：自包含的 DSH 插件包，将 DSH 注册为 MCP 工具提供方，支持多设备。

after.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
after.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DSH 工具接给小智语音助手，支持多个设备。

before.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
before.zh: DSH 网页界面中的 OpenViking：Studio 面板、按会话显示的记忆提交状态胶囊及其提交时间线，以及展示当前会话检索内容的右侧栏标签页。

after.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
after.zh: 在 OpenViking Studio 面板管理记忆，在会话中查看记忆保存记录和检索内容。

before.en: Gotify notifications when DSH session turns end: a host and browser plugin bundle, configurable in the Settings UI.
before.zh: DSH 会话轮次结束时的 Gotify 通知插件：宿主与浏览器插件包，可在设置界面中配置。

after.en: Gotify notifications when DSH session turns end: a host and browser plugin bundle, configurable in the Settings UI.
after.zh: 在会话轮次结束时发送 Gotify 通知，可在设置页配置。

before.en: Cons Auto Review
before.zh: Cons Auto Review

after.en: DCAR
after.zh: Con's 自动审查（DCAR）

before.en: Con's auto review (DCAR): a DeepSeek Harness tool review plugin that applies deterministic rules first and escalates to an LLM on demand, with a CAutoR permission mode.
before.zh: Con's 自动审查（DCAR）：确定性规则优先、LLM 按需升级的 DeepSeek Harness 工具审查插件，提供 CAutoR 权限模式。

after.en: Con's auto review (DCAR): a DeepSeek Harness tool review plugin that applies deterministic rules first and escalates to an LLM on demand, with a CAutoR permission mode.
after.zh: 优先按程序规则复核工具调用，复杂情况再交给模型，提供 CAutoR 权限模式。

before.en: Shows a Gemini quota bar in the DeepSeek Harness composer; clicking it opens a multi-account pool panel with per-account remaining quota, cooldown start/stop, keep-alive detection, and one-click account switching.
before.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框显示 Gemini 额度条，点开即为多账号池面板：逐账号查看剩余额度、启停冷却、检测保活，并可一键切换账号。

after.en: Shows a Gemini quota bar in the DeepSeek Harness composer; clicking it opens a multi-account pool panel with per-account remaining quota, cooldown start/stop, keep-alive detection, and one-click account switching.
after.zh: 在输入框查看 Gemini 额度，展开面板后管理多账号、冷却状态和账号切换。

before.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轮次结束时发送桌面通知：内置 Python/PowerShell 通知器，支持自定义命令回退，并提供独立的设置页。

after.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
after.zh: 在会话轮次结束时发送桌面通知，提供 Python/PowerShell 通知器，也可执行自定义通知命令。

before.en: Code Ui
before.zh: 代码编辑界面

after.en: Code UI
after.zh: 代码编辑界面

before.en: Cursor-style AI code workbench for DSH: file tree, tabbed editing, syntax highlighting, quote/translate tags for the AI, docked or floating layout.
before.zh: Cursor 风格的 AI 代码编辑器工作台插件（DSH）：文件树、多标签页编辑、语法高亮、可将引用/翻译内联标签提供给 AI，并支持右侧停靠或悬浮窗口双布局。

after.en: Cursor-style AI code workbench for DSH: file tree, tabbed editing, syntax highlighting, quote/translate tags for the AI, docked or floating layout.
after.zh: 提供 Cursor 风格代码工作台，支持文件树、多标签编辑、高亮、引用和翻译，可停靠或悬浮。

before.en: Shows oversized images to the model at a readable high resolution by tiling them before admission.
before.zh: 在接收前将超大图片分块，以清晰的高分辨率展示给模型。

after.en: Shows oversized images to the model at a readable high resolution by tiling them before admission.
after.zh: 将超大图片分块后提供给模型，保留可辨识的细节。

before.en: Centrally manages environment variables injected into the host, with allowlisted hot reload for plugins that read them only at startup (such as dsh-sql).
before.zh: 集中管理注入宿主的环境变量，并支持按白名单热重载那些启动时只读一次环境变量的插件（如 dsh-sql），免重启即可读取新值。

after.en: Centrally manages environment variables injected into the host, with allowlisted hot reload for plugins that read them only at startup (such as dsh-sql).
after.zh: 集中管理宿主环境变量，对允许的插件热重载，使其读取更新后的值。

before.en: Md Fix Tables
before.zh: Markdown 表格修复

after.en: MD Fix Tables
after.zh: Markdown 表格修复

before.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
before.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：对每次写入或编辑涉及的 Markdown 管道表格进行对齐，并报告所做的更改。

after.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
after.zh: 自动对齐写入或编辑的 Markdown 表格，并说明改动内容。

before.en: DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
before.zh: DSH 插件包：代理运行结束、需要审批或出错时，向 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 推送 Bark 通知。

after.en: DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
after.zh: 在任务完成、需要审批或出错时，通过 Bark 通知 iPhone 和 Apple Watch。

after.en: General-purpose calendar for the DSH right sidebar: month view with date selection, a list of the day's events, and today and week overviews; events are stored locally, and the agent can read and write via calendar_panel.
after.zh: 在侧栏月历中管理日程，查看当天及本周安排，支持 Agent 读写本地事件。

after.zh: 在新会话中注入简短的交接提示，没有交接文档时优先使用上一会话的压缩摘要。

before.zh: DSH 右侧栏的番茄钟：25 分钟专注与 5 分钟休息循环，计时在宿主侧运行，切换标签页或关闭面板都不会停止；Agent 也可通过 pomodoro_panel 工具读取状态并启停。

after.en: Pomodoro timer for the DSH right sidebar: 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, timed on the host; the agent can read status and start or stop it via pomodoro_panel.
after.zh: 在侧栏使用 25 分钟专注、5 分钟休息的番茄钟，关闭面板仍会计时，Agent 可查看和控制。

after.en: Calorie diary for the DSH right sidebar: a built-in food table auto-computes kcal from grams, logs by meal, and shows daily totals and goal progress; the agent can read and write via calorie_panel.
after.zh: 在侧栏记录饮食，按食物和重量计算热量，查看每日合计与目标进度，支持 Agent 读写。

after.en: Lightweight to-do list for the DSH right sidebar: one item per line, check off to complete, collapsible completed items; stored locally, and the agent can add, check and delete via todo_panel.

after.en: Finance terminal for the DSH right sidebar: cross-asset quotes, a rotating globe, a risk-appetite gauge, plain-Chinese explanations and related news, with two-way chat with the agent via finance_panel.
